text: 据财新，铁路将新增对应时速350公里以上列车的“X”字头字母，原有代表普速列车的字头字母“K”、“T”被用于代表高速列车。10月16日，中国国家铁路集团宣布近日已启动全国铁路列车车次编排改革。国铁集团表示，其将在11月下旬、12月下旬分2批对现行列车车次的字头字母、数字号段编排进行优化调整，实施新版《列车车次编排规定》，旅客货主可以通过变更后的列车车次直观了解列车速度、品质、功能等特征，同时新编码体系为未来客货列车开行规模扩大和新线路、新装备、新产品投用预留了充足空间。 此次调整主要分为客、货运列车车次。国铁集团称，与2014版列车车次的编排相比，动车组
text_en: According to Caixin, railways will add a new "X" prefix for trains with speeds of 350 km/h or above, while the existing prefixes "K" and "T," which originally represented conventional-speed trains, will be used to represent high-speed trains. On October 16, China State Railway Group announced that it had recently launched a reform of nationwide railway train numbering. China Railway said it will optimize and adjust the prefix letters and numerical number ranges of current train numbers in two batches in late November and late December, implementing the new version of the "Train Numbering Regulations." Passengers and cargo owners will be able to intuitively understand train characteristics such as speed, quality, and function through the changed train numbers, while the new numbering system reserves ample space for future expansion of passenger and freight train operations and the deployment of new lines, new equipment, and new products.
